verdict.rationale: Skyfire's core operations run headlessly over a REST API authenticated by the skyfire-api-key header: creating, charging and introspecting tokens and reading wallet balances. A hosted MCP server (with a sandbox endpoint) also lets agents run commerce workflows without a UI, and a live probe confirmed the token API responds with structured, key-gated errors. Missing for 10: CI-specific guidance or examples, a CLI, API-driven provisioning of keys and seller services (both are done in the dashboard, and services need Skyfire approval), and a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
